abilities.critical_failure: The creature takes double damage, 4d8 persistent bleed damage, and is drained 2.
abilities.effect: The spirits bite and chew, dealing 6d12+35 piercing damage to each creature within 30 feet. Affected creatures must each attempt a DC 41 Reflex save.
abilities.failure: The creature takes full damage, 2d8 persistent bleed damage, and is drained 1.
abilities.name: Feast
abilities.trigger: A living creature approaches within 10 feet

hazard.description: A pack of cannibalistic spirits swarm through the area, devouring living creatures.
hazard.disable: DC 40 Intimidation (master) to drive the spirits off with a ferocious display or DC 42 Occultism (expert) to exorcise the spirits
hazard.name: Cannibalistic Echoes
hazard.stealth: DC 42 (master) to sense something unusual lurking in the area's echoes

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
